subject.title: [Feature]: [Feature Request] 按用户维度统计 Token 使用量

question: Should OpenClaw core define a stable per-user accounting subject and viewer authorization model for token/cost usage reporting now, and which subject should back that accounting?
rationale: Current usage totals and origin metadata are not enough for billing-grade per-user views, and exposing per-user activity or spend crosses identity and authorization boundaries.

options.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
options.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

options.title: Wait For Principal Design
options.body: Keep this open but block implementation until Gateway multi-principal and per-message author attribution semantics settle.

options.title: Keep External Reporting Only
options.body: Document current usage exports and provider diagnostics as the supported path for custom spend dashboards until core has multi-user direction.

recommendation.title: Define Core Accounting Subject
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-approved accounting subject and viewer permission model, then extend usage RPCs and UI around that contract.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision crosses provider usage, Gateway usage RPCs, Dashboard reporting, and the documented security model where steipete has the strongest recent usage/Gateway history.
